purpose: Additional hand-authored development training and calibration, broadening short general questions, support, robot identity, ordinary followups, direct recall and optional personalization. Not a release or holdout evaluation.

provenance.authoring_basis: New contrasts authored from task requirements and broad grammar coverage, without opening fresh release files or copying old diagnostic prompts. Root independently handles old diagnostic examples.

limitations: This is authored development data. Counts do not establish representativeness, accuracy, calibration reliability, or safety guarantees.
Every contrastive group occupies exactly one split. Domains and broad grammar styles intentionally appear in both splits.
Calibration is development threshold-fitting data, not an independent performance estimate.
Only text and prior_turns are input features; other fields contain labels or provenance metadata.
Historical personal values are omitted. Draft histories are explicit fictional artifacts, and explanation histories contain general information.
Optional requests welcome personalization but remain answerable generally. A casual request for help without a memory dependency is none.

label_policy.none: Current input and general knowledge suffice, including short questions, present disclosures, ordinary support and resolved general or fictional-draft followups.
label_policy.optional: Personalization from permitted known context is invited but a useful general answer remains acceptable.
label_policy.required: The requested recall or constrained action depends on an unstated personal fact, including mixed requests whose independent general span is separately labelled.
label_policy.clarify: The task, object, referent or requested change lacks enough context even for a useful general answer.
label_policy.general_request: For mixed required cases only, the exact contiguous standalone general part, copied literally from text.
